title: PULSEmech Device Ledger Reproduction Result v0
description: Strict successful-result contract for the bounded PULSEmech Device Ledger Reproduction Capsule v0 execution. The result records an exact outer-launcher reference-environment attestation for the digest-pinned image, two isolated byte-identical Capsule constructions, two exact positive standalone-verifier executions, one structurally admissible package-signature mutation, the exact fail-closed rejection, protected-source preservation, and non-authority boundaries.
$comment: This schema defines the shape of a completed successful reproduction result.
